case.must_observe.1.rationale: Coverage table distinguishes supplied readable page 1/page 3 excerpts from unavailable page 2 approval decisions, while continuing supported flow/control identification. It does not imply the original whole document was inspected.

case.must_not_observe.1.rationale: No installation, fake OCR or guessed approver/threshold/approval route. Customer handover confirmation is not treated as quotation approval or quality acceptance; unobserved fee controls are not declared nonexistent.

variant.must_observe.1.rationale: Leaves the critical decision table Unresolved, requests human review/clear authoritative source and continues the independent two documented mechanisms rather than stopping all analysis.

limitations: Reviewer authored fixture/skill but not the answering run; not third-party assurance.
